title: Travel: John Lennon – Toronto to London | 1969
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono returned to London from Toronto, Canada, on 23 December 1969.

They had flown to Toronto on 16 December, and undertook a number of press appearances as well as meeting Canadian prime minister Pierre Trudeau earlier on this day.

On this afternoon they flew from Ottowa Airport to Toronto International Airport. They returned there later that evening for an overnight flight back to Heathrow Airport in London.
